mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hx_orders (order_no, user_id, session_id, seat_ids, ticket_count, total_amount, status, gmt_create) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{seatIds}, #{ticketCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(gmt_create) as date, COUNT(*) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as revenue FROM hx_orders WHERE gmt_create >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(gmt_create) ORDER BY date

SELECT m.id as movie_id, m.title as movie_title, COUNT(o.id) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) as revenue FROM hx_orders o INNER JOIN hx_sessions s ON o.session_id = s.id INNER JOIN hx_movies m ON s.movie_id = m.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY m.id, m.title ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.session_id, o.seat_ids, o.ticket_count, o.total_amount, o.status, o.trade_no, o.pickup_code, o.gmt_create, o.paid_at, o.cancelled_at, o.refunded_at, u.username, m.title as movie_title, c.name as cinema_name, h.name as hall_name, s.start_time FROM hx_orders o LEFT JOIN hx_users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN hx_sessions s ON o.session_id = s.id LEFT JOIN hx_movies m ON s.movie_id = m.id LEFT JOIN hx_cinemas c ON s.cinema_id = c.id LEFT JOIN hx_halls h ON s.hall_id = h.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
